map.生成签名或回调地址时需要精确控制编码范围：保留 / 与 : 而只编码参数值，避免: Generate signatures or callback URLs requiring precise control of the encoding scope: preserve / and : while only encoding the parameter value, to avoid signature validation failures from inconsistent encoding.
map.输入 `a/b` 选择“编码所有非安全字符”→ 输出 `a%2Fb`；选择保留路: Input `a/b` with "encode all non-safe characters" → output `a%2Fb`; with path separators preserved it stays `a/b`.
map.编码路径段时通常保留 /，编码查询值时应编码 /。: Usually preserve / when encoding a path segment; encode / when encoding a query value.
map.为什么两次编码结果不同？: Why do two encodings give different results?
map.因为 encodeURI 与 encodeURIComponent 的编码范围不: Because encodeURI and encodeURIComponent have different encoding scopes: the former preserves URL structural characters (: / ? # etc.) for encoding an entire URL; the latter encodes even those, for encoding a parameter value. Mixing them causes signature mismatch or parsing errors. The rule is simple: use the former for "entire URL", the latter for "parameter value".
